change.item: First stable release. From 1.0, setting names and values only change in a new major version; minor versions add features and patch versions fix bugs.
The step numbers option is called show_numbers (was numbers). Older layouts are migrated automatically when they load.

fix.item: Accordion Title HTML Element only accepts h2-h6 and div (h6 added to the list).
The link of the plain HTML copy stored for search is escaped.
No script error in browsers without the Web Animations getAnimations() method.

addition.item: Display options in the Content tab, as in YOOtheme's own elements: show or hide the badge, icon, image and link of all items without deleting them.
Lucide Icon field, with Icon Pro installed: a Lucide icon in the title instead of the UIkit icon.

First release: tabs or an accordion in one element. Tabs turn into an accordion below 640px or 960px. Underline, pill and segmented tab styles with a sliding indicator, tabs across the top or down the side, icons, step numbers and badges in the titles. A link to #name opens that tab, and the browser's find in page opens the tab holding the match.
